title: Export Browser History to CSV, JSON or HTML | HistoryOut
description:
Export your browser history as CSV, JSON or readable HTML. HistoryOut is free, works locally, and lets you choose the dates, matching pages and columns to include.

Install HistoryOut:
https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/historyout-export-chrome/idohnkdgejocejlkihihonhemndpiiei

Features, examples and browser options:
https://historyout.sauliusdev.chatgpt.site/

Choose your format first:
CSV for Excel, Google Sheets or another spreadsheet tool.
JSON for structured data and your own scripts.
HTML for a readable local file with clickable links.

Then make the file yours: choose a date range, filter by title or website, select your columns, and preview the matching results before downloading. Optional URL cleanup removes query strings and fragments; it does not anonymize your history.

When you want to revisit a page, use the daily recap, recent trail and saved views. These extras are free too.

Does HistoryOut upload my history?
No. It reads available browser history when you choose Preview or export. Files download to your device. No account or subscription is required.

Can it recover deleted history?
No. It uses history available to the current browser profile. Saved views remember settings, not a permanent copy of your history.

Check the changelog for the current release status:
https://historyout.sauliusdev.chatgpt.site/changelog/

Useful to you? You can optionally support my independent development. Every feature stays free:
https://www.buymeacoffee.com/saulius.developer

Recorded from the working extension with fictional browsing data. Narration is generated locally from my own voice reference, with original ambient music and click sounds.
